Agent Name: Coder
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Coder implemented a flawed pathfinding algorithm in the Python script. Instead of calculating the optimal or valid path to the END cell while strictly adhering to the "move two cells per turn" rule and avoiding blue cells, the code used a hardcoded placeholder logic (`proposed_position = (current_position[0] + 2, current_position[1])`). This assumed a straight vertical line down from the start, which is unlikely to be the correct path in a grid maze and ignores the specific coordinates of the START, END, and blue cells. Consequently, the script calculated the color of a cell on an incorrect trajectory, leading to the wrong answer (000000) instead of the correct one (F478A7).
